captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a stylized miniature toy sword or hilt component. It features a flat crossguard hilt with square diamond-rotated decorative blocks at the pommel end and at both tips of the crossguard. A central square diamond-rotated block sits at the junction of the handle and the guard, while the blade is rendered as a short, low-profile faceted polyhedron that tapers to a point.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric toy sword model in OpenSCAD. Define parameters for the blade length, blade side/center heights, handle width, and hilt width, as well as the sizes of the square decorative accents at the pommel and crossguard tips.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using basic 3D primitives and a custom polyhedron. The pommel is created with a rotated square cube, connected to a rectangular handle cube. The crossguard is formed by a perpendicular rectangular cube with two smaller rotated square cubes at its tips. A central rotated square block sits at the hilt-blade intersection. The blade itself is generated using the 'polyhedron' module with 12 defined points and 22 triangular faces to form a tapered, double-edged wedge shape.
